strings.zh: 听说狩猎场的园长有一只哈克龙,{NEWLINE}是被它从小养到大的。
strings.en: I hear the Safari Zone Warden has a{NEWLINE}Dragonair he’s raised from a baby.

strings.zh: 狩猎场搬到城都地区了……{SCROLL}但是,相对的,{NEWLINE}园长的儿子在这{CLEAR}开了一家名为{CLEAR}联动公园的新店！
strings.en: The Safari Zone has been moved{NEWLINE}to Johto...{SCROLL}I hear that now the son of the Warden{NEWLINE}is going to run Pal Park!
strings.notes: US 0513/1 | US line kept (vanilla: Safari Zone moved to Johto); contradicts the hack’s Fuchsia Safari Zone, probably a leftover.

strings.zh: 你有没有去过狩猎场？{NEWLINE}那里能遇到好多少见的精灵呢！
strings.en: Have you been to the Safari Zone? You{NEWLINE}can find lots of rare Pokémon there!

strings.zh: 听说狩猎场园长的哈克龙{NEWLINE}最近得重病去世了,{CLEAR}园长他一定很伤心吧,{CLEAR}毕竟是陪伴了自己那么多年的精灵。
strings.en: I heard the Safari Zone Warden’s{NEWLINE}Dragonair died of a serious illness{CLEAR}recently. He must be heartbroken. It{CLEAR}was his partner for so many years.
strings.notes: Branch: Dragonair died (Secret Potion delivered too late?) vs recovered (0133 #97/#100).
